tasks.label: SHF: approved one-shot Oracle shift metadata check
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $credential = Get-Credential -UserName 'SHIFTER' -Message 'Approved Oracle connectivity and three-table column metadata only'; if ($null -eq $credential) { throw 'Credential prompt cancelled. No Oracle check performed.' }; $env:ORACLE_USER = $credential.UserName; $env:ORACLE_PASSWORD = $credential.GetNetworkCredential().Password; $env:ORACLE_CONNECT_STRING = 'SHIFTER/shfmorad@ctidbt_wfmt'; $env:ORACLE_READ_ONLY = 'true'; $env:ORACLE_ENABLED = 'true'; try { & node '.\apps\api\dist\oracle\check.js' '--metadata'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Approved Oracle diagnostic failed. Review only the redacted diagnostic error code.' } } finally { Remove-Item Env:ORACLE_PASSWORD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item Env:ORACLE_ENABLED -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Variable credential -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
